result.rationale: The error is explicitly located in Theorem 2.2 and its proof, where the derivation step combining (2.8), (2.9) and the Lemma leads to the (allegedly incorrect) closed-form W_ij formula shown in the theorem statement.

System claims Theorem 2.2's formula (2.10) is actually correct and Lean-verified, with only a lemma-citation gap in the proof; annotation claims formula (2.10) itself is incorrect. These are contradictory conclusions, not the same defect.
